notes.title: Soundtrack High Quality Audio Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The Nekojishi Original Soundtrack has been converted to be a native soundtrack item on Steam. This means that instead of finding your soundtrack files within the game installation folder, you can now access them directly in your Steam library.

In addition we’ve added a new FLAC version download which was derived from the original master files. Thank you for your continued support of Nekojishi!

The files included in the soundtrack are as follows:
[list]
[*] MP3: 320 Kbps 44.1 kHz
[*] FLAC: 48 kHz
[/list]
- From the team at Studio Klondike

https://store.steampowered.com/app/769180/Nekojishi_Original_Soundtrack/

notes.title: Announcing Nekojishi: Lin & Partners the direct sequel to Nekojishi!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31157122/3d219e5081b053751b9c9333dd76b4526fafc55d.png[/img]

We're proud to announce our next big game, Nekojishi: Lin & Partners, an adventure torn between Taiwanese folklore, animal spirit guys, and property development. Crowdfunding now on Kickstarter! 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/studioklondike/nekojishi-lin-and-partners]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/studioklondike/nekojishi-lin-and-partners[/url]

[previewyoutube=a0ht2Bmorjk;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31157122/725122618e50304561eabb184d936a40c9c2d448.jpg[/img]

An adventure torn between tradition, animal spirits, and woebegone property owners. Adventure through Taiwan and uncover the secrets of the spiritual world as you get to know animal gods and spirits who all have their own reasons for messing with you and the world of the living.

[b]Nekojishi: Lin & Partners is an adventure-RPG that combines adventure game gameplay with real-time debate combat!  [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31157122/6c298191c7a3ffe581f58e26b52f6cb23efbcf10.jpg[/img]

[h1]Features[/h1] [list]
[*]     Explore Taiwan and uncover the secrets of the spiritual world in a cute, narrative focused adventure-RPG.
[*]     Interact with characters to learn more about their world and find info along the way.
[*]     Face off against spirits in debates using collected info to help bring them to your side.
[*]     Delve into a game deep with world history and references to religion and traditions based in Taiwan.
[/list]

Explore a wide game world, talk to characters, and help them out in quests— solving puzzles and learning more about local history and traditions. When things come to a head, you'll need to prove the truth and face-off against spirits in real-time RPG debate battles. Make smart use of the information you've acquired to face every rebuttal of your opponents!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31157122/6dcb18f24ebfa45f7ba6d274e23a1c15dea57a02.jpg[/img]

[h1]Story[/h1]
Take the reins at Lin & Partners Architects LLP, an architecture firm specialising in the restoration of haunted locations, and solving the problems of the beast-man spirits dwelling within them.

As Lin & Partners grows, a larger company looms near. Liao and the others must uncover their motives and ideals for tradition in modern society.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31157122/ea05e47ba22a89f4c2a0ec3e59d44ba054e96f5d.jpg[/img]

The story of Lin & Partners takes place as Liao and the others start up their new business venture. Connect with both old and new faces as Liao finds himself deep within the world of gods and spirits once more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31157122/b881ae5d84d359609b5a6f0e56f104212576f92b.jpg[/img]

[b]If Nekojishi: Lin & Partners reaches it's crowdfunding goal it's set to release next year. Remember to check out the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/studioklondike/nekojishi-lin-and-partners]Kickstarter page,[/url] or if you feel like it follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/NekojishiTW]Twitter[/url], [url=http://facebook.com/nekojishi/]Facebook[/url], and join our [url=http://discord.gg/nekojishi]Discord[/url]!
[/b]

notes.title: Nekojishi v1.06 Released! [Anniversary Update]
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31157122/fa611e517fc4c8c0c5296d46fe86466ca4134310.jpg[/img]


[h1]Nekojishi Anniversary Update[/h1]

It's been over one year since Nekojishi was released! To celebrate, v1.06 has been released. This includes English script updates. A Japanese script revision is also underway!

Please look forward to further announcements coming soon! Please follow our [url=https://twitter.com/NekojishiTW]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://facebook.com/nekojishi]Facebook[/url] to keep up to date on anything new.


[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Updated English script for both base game and DLC.
[*]Updated Japanese script for the DLC.
[*]Partial Japanese script update for base game.
[/list]

PS: If you find any typos or mistakes left in the English script at this point, don't hesitate to send us an email at nekojishitw@gmail.com.

Partial Japanese script update for base game.

notes.title: New DLC packs are here!
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce a fully-fledged DLC expansion pack for Nekojishi - A Sunny Day, Nekojishi Voice Pack - Chinese, and full Japanese language support for Nekojishi all available RIGHT NOW!

[url=store.steampowered.com/app/570840/] Check out both new DLC packs on the store page![/url]

[h1][b]Nekojishi Expansion Pack: A Sunny Day[/b][/h1]

A completely new epilogue story that takes place after the ending of the main story with brand new character sprites and locations as well as 13 new CG's. (10 for the main story, 3 for the epilogue). [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/754770/Nekojishi_Expansion_Pack__A_Sunny_Day/] Check out the new expansion pack here![/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31157122/8040690522c782d5a352c558fab12e1387764539.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31157122/7ccacba8e19faafbd3afd1f00fd000eef53edcdf.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Nekojishi Voice Pack - Chinese[/b][/h1]

This pack adds full Chinese voice acting to the entire game! (Once installed the voice volume can be adjusted in the settings) 
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/848320/Nekojishi_Voice_Pack__Chinese/]Check out the store page for a preview of the new voices![/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31157122/f42f1d59e4da8150d816bc81f68d51a38c670f1f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Nekojishi v1.03 Has Been Released!
notes.content:
We've been hard at work over the last few months and are ready to bring you a completely revised English localisation along with fixes and polish all around! (Also the OST DLC has been updated with expanded metadata and high-res cover art!)

(Note: Saves from previous versions may not load correctly in v1.03. When you next launch the game, a screen will appear asking you to keep or archive your old saves.)


[h1]Nekojishi v1.03 Change Log[/h1]

[b]English:[/b]
[list][*]Completely revised English localisation.
[*]Rewritten text for better prose quality, consistent characterisation, readability, and accuracy to the source material.
[*]Rewritten decision dialogues to better represent the choices being made. (Be sure to update those guides!)
[*]Reworked all ending “blog” sequences to vastly improve readability and writing quality.
[*]The names of some endings have been updated. (Be sure to also update guides with these!)
[*]Certain secondary characters have had their name tags changed on their dialogue boxes. 
[*]Fixed lines which missed some text changes made to the Chinese scripts before v1.00 and v1.02.
[*]Resolved issues where the newline cursor would appear too close to a text block.
[*]Resolved issues where the newline cursor would appear alone on a new line.
[*]Resolved issues where punctuation was displayed incorrectly.
[*]The control text on the bottom of the main menu has been re-worded for clarity.
[*]The “Replay” tool-tip on the main menu now reads “Gallery”.
[*]In the pause menu “Records” has been changed to “Save/Load”.
[*]The “About” screen has been updated to fix typos.
[*]Various other typos have been corrected.[/list]
[b]General:[/b]
[list][*]Resolved issues where the side portraits would not appear for some lines.
[*]Improved the music looping for certain ending “blog” sequences.
[*]Added the ability to delete and archive your old save files from previous versions to prevent errors when loading saves in Nekojishi v.1.03. (Note: This process does not change overall ending or glossary completion).[/list]
[b]Nekojishi OST:[/b]
[list][*]Updated metadata including high res cover art.
[*]Included even higher res (3000x3000 pixel) cover art in the OST folder.[/list]

[*]Resolved issues where punctuation was displayed incorrectly.
[*]The “About” screen has been updated to fix typos.
[*]Resolved issues where the side portraits would not appear for some lines.

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Fan-Art Competition!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

In an upcoming update we’re working on adding steam trading cards and backgrounds to Nekojishi. In order to make this happen we’ve decided to recruit our awesome fans to produce artwork to go alongside our own cards and backgrounds. This is your chance to have your art featured in the Steam version of Nekojishi! 

After the submission stage, a public voting stage will begin where everyone gets to vote on the 15 best artworks! (12 Trading Cards and 3 Profile Backgrounds) The one month submission stage begins 25/1 and will run until 25/2. Voting will begin on 27/2.

You’re free to enter on Sina Weibo, Facebook, Twitter, or Plurk. Further details and updates can be found on our Twitter and other three social media platforms.

We’re looking forward to seeing everyone’s entries!
- Team Nekojishi

tags.feature: In an upcoming update we’re working on adding steam trading cards and backgrounds to Nekojishi.

notes.title: Store Page and Achievement Update
notes.content:
It's been a long time coming but we've finally updated the store page with new descrptions and screenshots as well as revised the achievement names and descriptions in preparation for an upcoming update!

[u]Changes:[/u]
[list]
[*] New English store description that better reflects the story and tone of Nekojishi.
[*] English screenshots. (Finally!) Think of these as a tease of the upcoming update!
[*] New achievement names and descriptions. These have been revised by our English editor to read better and more closely convey the reasons you unlocked them.
[/list]

Thanks for everyone's continued support!

- Team Nekojishi
